description: Creates a notification channel from a name, a type and that type's config fields. Choose the type with listNotificationTypes, then call getNotificationTypeFields for its field names: both are case-sensitive. A create that lacks a documented required field is refused rather than saved as a channel that never sends. Attach the channel with notificationIDList on createMonitor / updateMonitor, or pass applyExisting. A repeat call creates a second channel; to change one use updateNotification.

applyExisting.description: Attach this channel to every existing monitor now

config.description: The fields of this notification type, e.g. {"slackwebhookURL": "https://hooks.slack.com/…"} for slack. Call getNotificationTypeFields for the names.

isDefault.description: Enable by default for new monitors

name.description: Human-readable name for this notification channel

type.description: Notification type, e.g. slack, smtp, PagerDuty. Use listNotificationTypes for all options.

name: createNotification
title: Create Notification
